info.title: Jamf Pro API (baton-jamf surface)

license.name: Proprietary (vendor API; spec describes connector usage only)

info.description: Subset of the Jamf Pro Classic (/JSSResource) and Jamf Pro (/api) APIs called by baton-jamf. Classic POST/PUT bodies are XML and responses are requested as JSON (Accept: application/json). Jamf Platform API gateway mode is not covered. Source: client code (pkg/jamf/client.go, device_client.go, models.go, device_models.go); not verified against vendor docs.

servers.description: Jamf Pro instance URL (configured per tenant)

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Inventory section; repeated. The connector always sends GENERAL, HARDWARE, OPERATING_SYSTEM, USER_AND_LOCATION, DISK_ENCRYPTION and SECURITY; only GENERAL is returned when omitted.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-indexed page number. The connector requests page 0 first and increments until (page+1)*page-size >= totalCount.

parameters.name: page-size
parameters.description: Page size; set by the connector on every call.

bearerAuth.description: Token from /api/v1/auth/token or /api/v1/oauth/token; sent via Authorization header

username.description: Login name; connector falls back to name when empty

sites.description: Live tenants return a flat list of {id,name}; the documented Classic shape wraps each entry as {site:{id,name}}. The connector accepts both.

expires.description: Parsed as RFC 3339; if it doesn't parse, the connector assumes the token lasts 15 minutes

emailAddress.description: No v4 key; kept as connector fallback

partitionFileVault2State.description: Enum string, e.g. ENCRYPTED / NOT_ENCRYPTED / DECRYPTED; full value set unproven

ComputerInventory.description: Sections other than id/udid are present only when requested via section.

username.description: Empty string clears the assignee and auto-populated fields; null/{} are silent no-ops
